jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Los Angeles, CA or Austin, TX
jobs.description:
About Truemed

Our mission is to reverse chronic illness back to 1970s levels and make Americans healthy again. We will do this by shifting hundreds of billions of dollars away from our current broken healthcare system, and towards effective lifestyle interventions and prevention. Today's healthcare system spends less than 3% of the $4.3T in annual spending on prevention. This has to change.

Today, 95% of all medical costs go to treating illness. Our goal is to empower people to invest in healthy habits today rather than treating illness in the future. We do this by supporting these 5 habits that research shows are tied to significantly improved health outcomes:

1. Eating healthy food

2. Getting an adequate quantity and quality of sleep

3. Increasing movement and exercise and reducing sedentary behavior

4. Reducing chronic stress

5. Increasing sunlight and minimizing environmental toxins

Truemed enables patients to use pretax HSA/FSA funds to buy healthy food, exercise equipment, and supplements. We support brands like Peloton, Eight Sleep, Momentous, and hundreds of others. We're building the infrastructure that allows health and wellness merchants to accept the $150+ billion tied up in HSA and FSA accounts. By allowing consumers to spend these pre-tax dollars on goods that make them healthier, we'll incentivize consumers to invest in their health and begin to reverse the explosion in chronic illness that's plagued the US for the last 50 years.



Why This Role Matters

• Truemed's marketplace sends meaningful, high-intent HSA/FSA traffic to merchant partners like Peloton, NOBULL, REP Fitness, and dozens of other leading health and wellness brands. Today, that demand generation happens organically. This role transforms it into a structured affiliate program where merchants agree to formalized terms in exchange for co-marketing commitments and support from Truemed.

• The Affiliate Marketing Manager owns the affiliate program end-to-end — consolidating Truemed's affiliate footprint across platforms and channels into a single operating model, refining and scaling the merchant framework, and building a program that turns Truemed's marketing efforts into a revenue-driving asset.

• This role directly impacts Truemed's revenue diversification and strengthens the strategic value of every merchant relationship.



About the Role

• We are hiring an Affiliate Marketing Manager to own Truemed's affiliate program — a distinct, opt-in merchant program that complements the Truemed merchant experience.

• This is an operator role inside Marketing. You'll own the program's economics, platform operations across partner affiliate networks (Impact, UpPromote, CJ, Everflow), program reporting (revenue, enrollment, deliverable fulfillment), and the value narrative that positions the affiliate program to prospective members.

• You'll work closely with our Partner Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Sales, and Merchant Success teams, who execute the deliverables and run the commercial conversations this role supports.



What You'll Do

Program Operations

• Own the Truemed Affiliate Program end-to-end: membership operations, tracking setup, commission structure, payout operations, and ongoing program management across multiple affiliate networks.

• Define and maintain the program's commission structure and member benefits — what affiliate members pay, what they receive, and the economics that make it work for both the merchant and Truemed.

• Partner with Finance to structure payment flows, invoicing, and revenue recognition for affiliate-sourced transactions across all networks.

Deliverables Fulfillment

• Maintain and evolve the standard set of deliverables offered at each enrollment level.

• Serve as the single point of truth for each affiliate member's deliverable schedule — briefing affiliate-specific asks into Partner Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, and other execution teams, and confirming everything lands.

• Maintain the affiliate program's marketing inventory: the full list of deliverables available to members, their quality standards, and their capacity constraints.

Program Growth & Reporting

• Build and maintain the value story and ROI case for the affiliate program, both internally and externally.

• Act as the affiliate program's subject matter expert in merchant conversations — presenting inventory, explaining economics, and walking merchants through what they unlock by opting in.

• Deliver quarterly affiliate-member reporting so every member sees the data that justifies their investment.

• Own program-level reporting: member count, enrollment pipeline, affiliate-attributed revenue, deliverable fulfillment rate, and churn.



What Success Looks Like

• The Truemed Affiliate Program runs on a single, documented operating model with clear membership economics, deliverable standards, and tracking across every affiliate network.

• A growing number of merchants are opted into the affiliate program, with tracking, commissions, and deliverable schedules confirmed across the full platform stack.

• Affiliate-attributed revenue becomes a measurable and growing line item, reported consistently and reconciled cleanly across networks.

• Every affiliate member receives their agreed-upon deliverables, on spec and on time.

• Merchant partners view the affiliate program as a fair value exchange because the data clearly shows what Truemed drives for their business.

• Sales, Merchant Success, and Partner Marketing have current, data-backed value materials that make the affiliate conversation easier.

• Leadership has clear visibility into the affiliate pipeline, enrollment progress, and program revenue through reliable reporting.



Who You Are

• Operationally rigorous — you build systems, playbooks, and calendars that keep a multi-platform, multi-member program clean.

• Data-driven — you lead with numbers and can translate transaction data into compelling value stories, program economics, and member reporting.

• A self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and is comfortable building a program from scratch.

• An excellent communicator and subject matter expert — you can present a program's inventory and value proposition directly to merchant marketing teams without it becoming a sales pitch.

• Energized by cross-functional collaboration.



Compensation and Benefits

• Comp and equity in the top decile for Series A startups

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer sponsored HSA contributions

• 401(k)

• Unlimited PTO

• Coworking stipend

• L&D Stipend

• 2x/year company offsites and 2x/year team offsite



Location

• Los Angeles preferred / SF / Austin // Hybrid

1. Eating healthy food

Truemed enables patients to use pretax HSA/FSA funds to buy healthy food, exercise equipment, and supplements. We support brands like Peloton, Eight Sleep, Momentous, and hundreds of others. By allowing consumers to spend these pre-tax dollars on goods that make them healthier, we'll incentivize consumers to invest in their health and begin to reverse the explosion in chronic illness that's plagued the US for the last 50 years.



Why This Role Matters

• Truemed's merchant network is growing rapidly across health and wellness verticals — fitness equipment, supplements, nutrition, recovery, sleep, and beyond. Each merchant that launches with Truemed needs hands-on guidance through onboarding, activation, and ongoing optimization to unlock the full value of HSA/FSA purchasing for their customers.

• The Customer Success Manager is the merchant's primary partner at Truemed. This role ensures that partners are onboarded efficiently, activated successfully, and supported with the data, campaigns, and co-marketing strategies that drive transaction volume and long-term retention. As Truemed's merchant base scales, this role becomes the foundation of our partner experience.



About the Role

• We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Truemed merchant partners across the full merchant lifecycle — from onboarding and technical activation through ongoing engagement, co-marketing support, and performance optimization.

• Your portfolio will include a mix of mid-market and growth-stage health and wellness brands integrating Truemed into their checkout flows to accept HSA/FSA payments.

• Day-to-day, you will serve as the primary point of contact for your merchants — guiding them through implementation, coordinating co-marketing efforts with Truemed's growth marketing team, analyzing performance data to identify growth opportunities, and ensuring every partner is positioned to drive meaningful HSA/FSA transaction volume.

• This role reports to the Head of Customer Success and works cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Growth, Product, and Solutions Engineering. You will collaborate closely with the Sr. CSM team on shared playbooks, processes, and best practices.

• This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, analytical, and genuinely passionate about helping merchants succeed while uncovering new revenue opportunities for Truemed.



What You'll Do

• Own a portfolio of Truemed merchant partners across health and wellness verticals, managing the full lifecycle from onboarding through ongoing optimization.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for your merchants, building strong relationships with key stakeholders and providing responsive, high-quality support.

• Partner with Truemed's growth marketing team to develop and execute co-marketing initiatives that drive consumer awareness and HSA/FSA adoption on merchant sites.

• Analyze merchant performance data — transaction volume, conversion rates, campaign results — to identify optimization opportunities and build data-driven growth plans.

• Proactively monitor merchant health across your portfolio, identifying risks early and developing action plans to improve engagement and retention.

• Manage multiple merchant accounts simultaneously, staying organized across onboarding timelines, campaign launches, and ongoing check-ins.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Growth to resolve merchant issues and surface product feedback.

• Identify expansion opportunities within your portfolio — additional product lines, deeper co-marketing commitments, and new use cases.

• Contribute to the development of scalable CS processes, playbooks, and templates that improve efficiency and consistency across the team.



What Success Looks Like

• Partner engagement is high — merchants are responsive, participating in co-marketing initiatives, and actively growing their HSA/FSA transaction volume.

• You are consistently identifying and acting on optimization opportunities using performance data.

• Merchant retention across your portfolio is strong, with partners viewing Truemed as a valuable growth channel.

• Cross-functional teams receive timely, actionable feedback from your merchant interactions.

• You are contributing to scalable CS processes that improve the team's ability to serve a growing merchant base.



Who You Are

• A relationship builder who earns trust quickly and communicates with clarity and warmth.

• Organized and detail-oriented — you can manage a portfolio of accounts without letting things slip through the cracks.

• Analytical — you are comfortable working with data, building reports, and translating metrics into actionable insights.

• A proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of merchant issues and follows through to resolution.

• An effective communicator who can engage with merchant teams, brief internal stakeholders, and present performance updates with confidence.

• Collaborative — you thrive in cross-functional environments and enjoy working across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities shift and ownership is expected.

• Mission-driven — you believe in what Truemed is building and want to help merchants and consumers benefit from it.



Qualifications

• 3–4+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management, ideally in e-commerce, DTC, marketplace, or SaaS.



Compensation and Benefits

• Comp and equity in the top decile for Series A startups

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer sponsored HSA contributions

• 401(k)

• Unlimited PTO

• Coworking stipend

• L&D Stipend

• 2x/year company offsites and 2x/year team offsite

• Los Angeles preferred / SF / Austin // Hybrid

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Los Angeles, CA or Austin, TX
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRUEMED

Truemed is building the payment infrastructure for better health. Our platform helps qualified consumers use HSA/FSA funds on eligible health and wellness purchases while helping merchants unlock a powerful new growth channel through compliant eligibility and substantiation workflows. By removing the complexity around eligibility, compliance, and reimbursement, Truemed allows partners to offer seamless HSA/FSA purchasing experiences directly within their checkout flows.

More than a million people have used Truemed to put pre-tax dollars toward health purchases from brands like Peloton, NOBULL, Thorne, Garmin, and dozens more. On truemed.com http://truemed.com, they can discover what else their HSA or FSA covers, all in one place.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Most people meet Truemed at a merchant's checkout. They're buying a sauna, a treadmill, or a supplement, and along the way they learn their HSA or FSA can help pay for it. Lifecycle marketing is how that first purchase becomes a lasting relationship.

Many of our customers are still learning what their benefits can do. Every email and text is a chance to help. We can show them what else is eligible, remind them before their funds expire, and bring them back to truemed.com http://truemed.com when they're ready for their next purchase.

We have a strong foundation to build on. That includes a weekly newsletter with a large, engaged audience, a product catalog connected to Klaviyo, and real-time events from our product that show where each customer is in their journey. This role will own that program and grow it.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on role. Expect roughly 70% building and shipping and 30% strategy, testing, and reporting. You'll own email and SMS end to end. That means building the journeys, writing the copy, launching the sends, and reporting on what they drove.

You'll report to the Head of Consumer Marketing and work with Product Engineering on events and data, with Partner Marketing on merchant partner sends, and with Content on editorial.

We're open on level. Candidates with deeper experience owning a channel target and a roadmap will be considered for Senior.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer journeys

 - Own Truemed's Klaviyo flows across the customer journey, including welcome and onboarding, post-purchase, cross-sell, win-back, and seasonal deadline reminders

 - Design the path that brings customers who first found us at a merchant's checkout back to truemed.com http://truemed.com for their next purchase

 - Connect journeys to the events our product emits, such as a completed eligibility check or an issued letter of medical necessity, and partner with Product Engineering on new events

 - Build dynamic, personalized content with Klaviyo's template language and product catalog, so each customer sees products relevant to them

 - Keep the Klaviyo product catalog, which syncs from our Sanity CMS, accurate and fresh

Campaigns and content

 - Run the campaign calendar, including the Truemed Weekly newsletter, seasonal moments, and the year-end FSA deadline

 - Write the copy. Subject lines, preview text, body copy, and SMS, in Truemed's voice and inside the compliance guardrails of a health payments company

 - Build and QA emails in Stripo and Klaviyo, and edit HTML when a template needs it

 - Run partner-featured email and SMS sends with our merchant partners, and report back on how each one performed

SMS

 - Own the SMS program on Klaviyo, including campaigns, SMS journeys, consent capture, and TCPA compliance

 - Grow the SMS audience through on-site forms and the eligibility experience

Audience and on-site

 - Own segmentation, frequency, and deliverability so every customer hears from us at the right pace

 - Own lifecycle touchpoints on truemed.com http://truemed.com, including signup forms and the Sanity-managed pages and product cards that emails link to

Measurement and testing

 - Run an always-on testing program covering subject lines, send times, content, and journey structure

 - Report on engagement, repeat purchase, and revenue by journey and campaign

 - Own the Email and SMS channel targets in our quarterly plan



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, success means:

 - Customers who first found Truemed at a merchant's checkout come back to truemed.com http://truemed.com for a second purchase, and that share grows quarter over quarter

 - Every customer gets real value from hearing from us. They understand their benefits better, discover eligible products they didn't know about, and know when their funds are about to expire

 - Journeys meet customers at each stage, from first purchase to loyal repeat buyer, and drive a growing share of lifecycle revenue

 - Email and SMS hit or beat their channel targets while engagement and deliverability stay healthy

 - Merchant partners see clear results from the sends that feature them

 - Testing is a habit, and the program gets measurably better every quarter



WHO YOU ARE

 - Customer-first. You think about what each message gives the customer, not only what we want from it

 - A Klaviyo expert. You've built flows on custom events, used catalog data in templates, and know how to troubleshoot when something doesn't fire

 - Technical enough to work directly with engineers. You can read an event payload, write a clear spec, and use the API when it's the faster path

 - A strong writer. You can write a subject line that earns the click and explain HSA/FSA to someone who has never used theirs

 - Detail-oriented. You catch broken links, merge-tag errors, and rendering issues before a send goes out

 - Driven by data. You measure a send by what it drove, not its open rate

 - Excited to build in a fast-growing startup

 - Interested in health and wellness and in the brands on our marketplace



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, ideally at a high-volume ecommerce, DTC, or marketplace business (6+ years for Senior)

 - A track record of growing repeat purchase rate or customer lifetime value through lifecycle programs

 - Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience across flows, segments, custom events and metrics, catalog, SMS, and the template language

 - Experience running SMS programs, including consent and TCPA compliance

 - A portfolio of email and SMS copy you wrote yourself

 - Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email and of email builders like Stripo

 - Experience with lifecycle attribution, reporting, and structured A/B testing


Preferred

 - Experience with a headless CMS (Sanity strongly preferred; Contentful or similar)

 - SQL or BI experience (Omni, Looker, Snowflake)

 - Familiarity with the Klaviyo API, GTM, or on-site identity and tracking

 - Experience in health and wellness, fintech, or another regulated category (HSA/FSA experience is a strong plus)

 - Experience running brand-partner or co-branded campaigns

 - Comfort using AI tools to draft, build, and QA campaigns faster



LOGISTICS

 - Location: Los Angeles or Austin required // Hybrid
